name: Bonding, Now
source: A black-and-white stylized collection of visual novel stories with pixel graphics gameplay and lineart artwork. Each story might have a different setting, but the characters repeat like actors throughout movies. The common motive of all the stories is the bonding of people in everyday life, regardless of where and when.
translation: A black-and-white stylized collection of visual novel stories with pixel graphics gameplay and lineart artwork. Each story might have a different setting, but the characters repeat like actors throughout movies. The common motive of all the stories is the bonding of people in everyday life, regardless of where and when.
